concerns.text: The `outcome_model` enum in `contracts/estimation_result.schema.yaml` lists `quadratic`, but the tasks (e.g., T002, T005, T006, T007, T008, T009) use the identifier `quadratic_missing_sine`. This mismatch will cause schema validation failures for all `EstimationResult` and `AggregatedMetrics` artifacts, making the associated tasks unexecutable until the schema is updated to include `quadratic_missing_sine` (or the tasks are changed to use `quadratic`).
